```{r}
## Loading the libraries
```

```{r}
ldata_fread <- fread("tu_new.csv")
str(ldata_fread)

###We used Apache Arrow and the Parquet format because the NLMS Tobacco Use dataset is large (~493,000 observations with many variables), and base R data handling becomes inefficient and memory-intensive at this scale.

write_parquet(ldata_fread, "tu_new.parquet")
ds <- open_dataset("tu_new.parquet")
```

```{r}

df <- ds %>%
  dplyr::select(curruse,race, age, sex,ms,histatus,adjinc,inddea,smokstat,smok100,agesmk,everuse) %>%
  collect()

ds_mod <- df %>%
  mutate(
    curruse = as.character(curruse),
    curruse_recode = case_when(
      grepl("1", curruse) ~ 1,  # any “1” anywhere → Yes
      curruse == "22222" ~ 0,   # all “2”s → No
      TRUE ~ NA_real_           # any “9” or invalid → Missing
    )
    )%>%
    mutate(
    everuse = as.character(everuse),
    everuse_recode = case_when(
      grepl("1", everuse) ~ 1,          # any “1” anywhere → Yes
      everuse == "22222" ~ 0,           # all “2”s → No
      TRUE ~ NA_real_                   # any “9” or invalid → Missing
    )
    )%>%
   mutate(
    ms_recode = case_when(
      ms == 1 ~ 1,                # Married
      ms %in% c(2, 3,4,5) ~ 0,     # Widowed, Separated,Divorced, Never married → Not married
      TRUE ~ NA_real_             # Missing or unknown
    )
  )


```


```{r}
set.seed(123)

n <- nrow(ds_mod)
n
train_index <- sample(1:n, size = 0.7 * n)

train_data <- ds_mod[train_index, ]
nrow(train_data)
head(train_data)
test_data  <- ds_mod[-train_index, ]
nrow(test_data)
#View(test_data)

class(train_data$smokstat)
unique(train_data$smokstat)
unique(test_data$smokstat)

train_data$smokstat <- factor(train_data$smokstat)
train_data$smokstat
test_data$smokstat <- factor(test_data$smokstat)
test_data$smokstat
sum(complete.cases(train_data))
sum(complete.cases(test_data))



## Exposure : Smokestat, Reference = Never smoker
model_smoking <- glm(inddea~ smokstat + age + factor(race) +sex+ factor(histatus) +adjinc + factor(ms_recode),
                  family = binomial,
                  data = train_data)
summary(model_smoking)
exp(coef(model_smoking)) # Odds ratios

test_data <- na.omit(test_data)
# Now predict
pred_prob_m1 <- predict(model_smoking, newdata = test_data, type = "response")

pred_prob_m1 

library(pROC)
roc(test_data$inddea, pred_prob_m1)
plot(roc(test_data$inddea, pred_prob_m1), col="blue", main="ROC Curve Model 1")

### Exposure : Duration (Smokestat + agesmk, Reference = everyday smoker)

model_smoking_duration <- glm(inddea ~ smokstat+ agesmk+ age + factor(race)+factor(sex)+factor(histatus)+adjinc+factor(ms_recode),
                  family = binomial,
                  data = train_data)
summary(model_smoking_duration)
exp(coef(model_smoking_duration)) # Odds ratios

pred_prob_m2 <- predict(model_smoking_duration, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
pred_prob_m2



roc1 <- roc(test_data$inddea, pred_prob_m1)
roc2 <- roc(test_data$inddea, pred_prob_m2)
roc.test(roc1, roc2)  # test if the difference in AUC is significant


AIC(model_smoking, model_smoking_duration)
BIC(model_smoking, model_smoking_duration)
```

```{r}
# Install if needed
#install.packages("caret")
library(caret)
set.seed(123)


# Convert outcome to factor for classification
ds_mod$inddea <- factor(ds_mod$inddea, levels = c(0,1))
n <- nrow(ds_mod)
n
train_index <- sample(1:n, size = 0.7 * n)

train_data <- ds_mod[train_index, ]
nrow(train_data)
head(train_data)
test_data  <- ds_mod[-train_index, ]
nrow(test_data)

train_data$smokstat <- factor(train_data$smokstat)
train_data$smokstat
test_data$smokstat <- factor(test_data$smokstat)
test_data$smokstat

# Define 5-fold CV
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",   # cross-validation
  number = 5,      # 5 folds
  classProbs = TRUE, # needed if you want probabilities
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary # allows AUC calculation
)

train_data <- na.omit(train_data)
test_data <- na.omit(test_data)


train_data$inddea <- factor(train_data$inddea, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
test_data$inddea  <- factor(test_data$inddea, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))

# Train logistic regression with 5-fold CV
set.seed(123) # for reproducibility
cv_model1 <- train(
  inddea ~  smokstat + age + factor(race) +sex+ factor(histatus) +adjinc + factor(ms_recode),
  data = train_data,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = train_control,
  metric = "ROC" # optimize based on AUC
)

# View CV results
cv_model1

cv_model2 <- train(
  inddea ~ smokstat+ agesmk+ age + factor(race)+factor(sex)+factor(histatus)+adjinc+factor(ms_recode),
  data = train_data,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = train_control,
  metric = "ROC" # optimize based on AUC
)

# View CV results
cv_model2

## predicting the probabilities
pred_probs1 <- predict(cv_model1, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")$Yes
pred_probs2 <- predict(cv_model2, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")$Yes

## Checking ROC
rocCV1 <- roc(test_data$inddea, pred_probs1)
rocCV2 <- roc(test_data$inddea, pred_probs2)
roc.test(rocCV1, rocCV2)

# ROC Plot
plot(rocCV1, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve: Model Comparison")
lines(rocCV2, col = "red")
legend("bottomright", legend = c("Model 1: smokstat", "Model 2: smokstat+agesmk"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)

```




```{r}

# Smoking model
cutoff_10_1 <- quantile(pred_prob_m1, 0.90)
pred_class_top10 <- ifelse(pred_prob_m1 >= cutoff_10_1, 1, 0)
cm_top10 <- table(
  Predicted = pred_class_top10,
  Actual = test_data$inddea
)
cm_top10
TP <- cm_top10["1","1"]
FP <- cm_top10["1","0"]

precision_top10 <- TP / (TP + FP)
precision_top10

# smoking + duration model
cutoff_10_2 <- quantile(pred_prob_m2, 0.90)
pred_class_top10_2 <- ifelse(pred_prob_m2 >= cutoff_10_2, 1, 0)
cm_top10_2 <- table(
  Predicted = pred_class_top10_2,
  Actual = test_data$inddea
)
cm_top10_2
TP <- cm_top10_2["1","1"]
FP <- cm_top10_2["1","0"]

precision_top10_2 <- TP / (TP + FP)
precision_top10_2

```


```{r}
precision_at_k <- function(pred_prob, outcome, k) {
  cutoff <- quantile(pred_prob, 1 - k)
  pred_class <- ifelse(pred_prob >= cutoff, 1, 0)
  
  cm <- table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = outcome)
  
  TP <- cm["1", "1"]
  FP <- cm["1", "0"]
  
  precision <- TP / (TP + FP)
  return(precision)
}
ks <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.20)

precision_m1 <- sapply(ks, precision_at_k,
                        pred_prob = pred_prob_m1,
                        outcome = test_data$inddea)

precision_m2 <- sapply(ks, precision_at_k,
                        pred_prob = pred_prob_m2,
                        outcome = test_data$inddea)

data.frame(
  Risk_Percentile = c("Top 5%", "Top 10%", "Top 20%"),
  Smoking_Only = precision_m1,
  Smoking_Duration = precision_m2
)
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Percentile = rep(c(5, 10, 20), 2),
  Precision = c(precision_m1, precision_m2),
  Model = rep(c("Smoking only", "Smoking + duration"), each = 3)
)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Percentile, y = Precision, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5, 10, 20)) +
  labs(
    x = "High-risk group (Top % of predicted risk)",
    y = "Precision (PPV)",
    title = "Precision across high-risk percentiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
baseline_rate <- mean(test_data$inddea, na.rm = TRUE)
baseline_rate
lift_m1 <- precision_m1 / baseline_rate
lift_m2 <- precision_m2 / baseline_rate

data.frame(
  Risk_Percentile = c("Top 5%", "Top 10%", "Top 20%"),
  Lift_Smoking_Only = lift_m1,
  Lift_Smoking_Duration = lift_m2
)

```
